# Tech level projects: generated by tech_level_projects.py in the Brainstorming workspace.
# Only for nations that completed the opening focus of a generic tree; only the next level of a branch is shown.

sp_tech_level_infantry_tribal = {
	specialization = specialization_land
	project_tags = sp_tag_tech_level
	prototype_time = sp_time.prototype.short
	complexity = sp_complexity.small

	breakthrough_cost = {
		specialization_land = 1
	}

	visible = {
		FROM = {
			OR = {
				has_completed_focus = gs_opening1
				has_completed_focus = GR_gangs_origin
				has_completed_focus = tribal_past
				has_completed_focus = GenTalonLore1
				has_completed_focus = genstable_opening1
			}
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_tech = infantry_tech_level_tribal }
				is_special_project_completed = sp:sp_tech_level_infantry_tribal
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 4
	}

	project_output = {
		country_effects = {
			set_technology = {
				infantry_tech_level_tribal = 1
				popup = no
			}
		}
	}
}

sp_tech_level_naval_tribal = {
	specialization = specialization_naval
	project_tags = sp_tag_tech_level
	prototype_time = sp_time.prototype.short
	complexity = sp_complexity.small

	breakthrough_cost = {
		specialization_naval = 1
	}

	visible = {
		FROM = {
			OR = {
				has_completed_focus = gs_opening1
				has_completed_focus = GR_gangs_origin
				has_completed_focus = tribal_past
				has_completed_focus = GenTalonLore1
				has_completed_focus = genstable_opening1
			}
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_tech = naval_tech_level_tribal }
				is_special_project_completed = sp:sp_tech_level_naval_tribal
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 4
		modifier = {
			factor = 0
			FROM = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_state = { is_coastal = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	project_output = {
		country_effects = {
			set_technology = {
				naval_tech_level_tribal = 1
				popup = no
			}
		}
	}
}
